QUALITY - The Large Xmas banner from Silvima is made from quality polyester in highest level quality control. No printing mistakes. We will never damp down your good holiday mood with a defective item!

EASY TO HANG - There are many ways for easy hanging this giant Merry Christmas decoration banner. You can tie this banner anywhere with the strings sewed in the corner. You can cut the strings off then thumbtack it. You can even use a tape to fix it. Please note that the stakes on the picture is NOT included.
SELFIE BACKDROP - Not only as holiday decoration, also great as a photo backdrop for a photograph of the whole family or selfie background!
